newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to evacuate 185 Europeans from Freetown.
newsitem.headline: France to evacuate 185 Europeans from Freetown.

text.p: French troops launched an operation to evacuate 185 Europeans from Freetown on Saturday, a spokesman for the Defence Ministry in Paris said.

"The operation is being carried out from a beach," the spokesman said, adding that Europeans earmarked for evacuation aboard the French warship Jean Moulin included 140 Britons and some 15 French nationals.
Officials said the evacuation had been approved by the junior officers who led a coup in Freetown.
Three battalions of troops from Guinea were heading for neighbouring Sierra Leone on Saturday to join a Nigerian-led regional force gearing up to reverse the coup, local military sources said.

Military sources said the Guineans could number up to 1,500, joining a force of about 3,000 Nigerians, most of them assembled in Sierra Leone since last Sunday's coup against elected President Ahmad Tejan Kabbah provoked wide condemnation.
